content: We need count of methyl groups in the molecule. But we have no description of molecule. Possibly need to get NMR spectra and infer? But maybe the molecule is given implicitly? No SMILES provided. Could be that the sample at hand is preloaded; we can get carbon NMR to see number of methyl carbons (CH3). Use carbon_nmr_spectra tool to get spectra. Then count distinct methyl carbon signals (around 10-30 ppm). Could also use proton NMR to see methyl peaks (singlet, doublet, etc). Probably easiest: get carbon NMR and count signals in methyl region (0-40 ppm). Let's call carbon_nmr_spectra.
